title: Educational officers' salary schedules.
bodyText: The salary schedule for all educational officers of the department shall be negotiated pursuant to section 89-9.
bodyHtml: §302A-625  Educational officers' salary schedules.  The salary schedule for all educational officers of the department shall be negotiated pursuant to section 89-9. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2; am L 2001, c 256, §3]
